operators.meaning: true when every operand is a finite Decimal and all are numerically equal ("0.03" equals "0.030"); a missing operand refuses with "Missing catalog ID" and a non-numeric or non-finite operand refuses with "Non-numeric catalog ID"
operators.authority: T57h coordinator decision (decision log item 193) under the Owner's delegation, 03/10/2026, before the release of any tier result

composition_code: the explicit joins (DS10-join, C1, CN01-join) no longer rewrite the text before the join point; they refuse with a ValueError naming the join when that text is empty, ends in a comment-only line, ends in a % comment that the joined text would follow on the same line or that is glued to the prose, or has a \par token on its last prose line; otherwise they join exactly as before T57g, and the composed Discussion and Conclusion of the twelve synthetic cases are byte-identical to those of 81c54614
